result.topic_en: Classification of the Gaussian integers a+bi (a,b = 1..6) modulo 7 into residue classes (apparently by biquadratic character), together with numerical tables for 2+2i, a reciprocity formula of the form (p)(q) ≡ ¼(P−1)(Q−1) mod 4, and a sketch of a lattice decomposition, with scattered pen trials and English/German words.

methods.what: Partition of the nonzero Gaussian residues mod 7 (a+bi, 0≤a,b≤6) into classes, apparently biquadratic residue classes
Table of biquadratic characters (indices 0–3) of numbers with respect to 2+2i / modulus 16
Reciprocity-type formula relating characters (p),(q) to (P−1)(Q−1)/4 mod 4
Squaring a number of form α+2x+2xi to get residues mod powers of 2
Parametrisation of residue classes of Gaussian integers modulo 16 / (4+4i)
Decomposition of a Gaussian integer into integer and fractional parts relative to a lattice (geometric sketch)
